title: Bruce W. Nichols Lecturer on Law
bio: Vladimir Bosiljevac has been lecturing courses on investments, private equity and M&A and conducting research in the areas of finance and economics at Harvard Law School and Harvard’s Department of Economics since 2009. For his teaching efforts at Harvard he won several teaching awards. Vladimir founded and runs an investment management platform for family offices […]
